info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Credit Margins API
info.description: The Credit Margins API provides financial institutions with access to real-time credit margin data. This allows users to retrieve critical information related to the margins applied to various credit models, enabling better financial decision-making and risk management. Typical consumers include banking analysts, risk managers, and financial advisors looking to evaluate credit policies and offers. With this API, businesses can enhance their credit assessment processes and improve transparency in financial operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access credit margins information. It is essential for understanding financial performance and risk management.
